params.name: statement
params.description:
Filters the transactions by statement. The available options are tenant , tenant-deposit , property-owner , 
 property-owner-consolidated , contractor , tenancy-closing-statement , late-rents , contingency-statement , invoices

params.name: allocated_from
params.description: Filter by transaction allocated from ID

params.name: status
params.description: The status of the transaction. The available options are paid , unpaid , partpaid , outstanding , overdue , or voided . Use this parameter to filter transactions based on their payment status.

params.name: transaction_type
params.description: Filter by the ID of the transaction type or by its alias name (Obtained from the v2/transaction_types endpoint)

params.name: date_from
params.description: Filters the transactions by the created date, starting from the specified date. Use the format yyyy-mm-dd to input the date.

params.name: date_to
params.description: Filters the transactions by the created date, up to the specified date. Use the format yyyy-mm-dd to input the date.

params.name: modifiedFrom
params.description: Filters the transactions by the modified date, starting from the specified date. Use the format yyyy-mm-dd to input the date.

params.name: modifiedTo
params.description: Filters the transactions by the modified date, up to the specified date. Use the format yyyy-mm-dd to input the date.

params.name: transaction_date_from
params.description: Filters the transactions by the date, starting from the specified date. Use the format yyyy-mm-dd to input the date.

params.name: transaction_date_to
params.description: Filters the transactions by the date, up to the specified date. Use the format yyyy-mm-dd to input the date.

params.description: When true, abort the request instead of auto-creating an unknown Simple type. POST and PUT only.

items.docs:
This API endpoint allows the user to payoff a transaction with a payment. The transaction is identified by its unique transaction_id and the payment details are included in the optional request body.

If no request body is included, the endpoint will pay off the full charge.

Supported Fields 
 The following fields are supported for the request body

Field 
 Data Type 
 Description 

description 
 string 
 A description of the payoff receipt. 

payment_method_id 
 integer 
 The ID of the payment
